task.question: In ice hockey, which team won their first Walter Cup on May 20, 2026?
task.evidence: May 20: The Montreal Victoire defeat the Ottawa Charge three games to one in the 2026 Walter Cup Finals to win their first Walter Cup.

answer:
The **Montréal Victoire** won their first Walter Cup on May 20, 2026. They became the first Canadian team — and the first team other than the Minnesota Frost — to win the PWHL championship, defeating the Charge in the Final.

FINAL: Montréal Victoire

messages.content: [Inside the stunning 72-hour Lakers sale -- and the uncertainty that still looms] BOB IGER WAS on his 213-foot sailing superyacht on Aug. 12, winding down a monthlong vacation in Europe following a historic, two-decade run as CEO of Disney. The biggest event of the day was supposed to be the first total solar eclipse over the continent in more than a century. Millions of tourists, including Iger, had booked vacations along the eclipse's path from Greenland to Southern Spain during the syzygy -- a word derived from Ancient Greek for "yoked together" -- which describes a rare astronomical event in which three or more celestial bodies align in a straight line. During a solar eclipse, the moon sits exactly between the sun and Earth, casting its shadow onto Earth. Some enjoy the rare view -- through special sunglasses. Others ascribe great meaning and magic to eclipses. As those tourists headed to viewing spots for the solar eclipse across Europe, Iger was in a wholly different syzygy with his longtime friend and business partner Josh Kushner and Los Angeles Lakers owner Mark Walter. The alignment of three financial heavy hitters was about to turn what should have been a once-in-a-generation event -- last year's record-breaking sale of the Lakers from the Buss family to Walter -- into the NBA's most shocking news -- again. Instead of getting into position to watch the solar eclipse, Iger was furiously working the phones from Italy to consummate a stunning event of his own -- a $12.5 billion sale of the Lakers seemingly out of nowhere, creating an eclipse unto itself across the worlds of sports and business. Little did anyone know that these secret, cross-continental talks were about to put the Lakers in significant transition yet again -- with new owners evaluating everything and everyone; squabbling former owners again jostling for power and money; and an overhauled roster finally built in the image of its superstar, Luka Doncic . The Valkyries, now -105 to win the title, began the series favored at -125, while the Dream were the +105 underdogs. Atlanta is the slight favorite (-115) heading into Game 5. Atlanta began the campaign with solid +650 odds to win the Finals, fourth on the odds board, but Golden State came in at a much longer 45-1, ninth on the board, in just its second season of existence. Angel Reese (-105) is the favorite for Finals MVP by the slimmest of margins, while Gabby Williams (+100) is right behind. With the rest of the field at 40-1 or longer odds, it appears bookmakers believe one of those two will win the honor based on whoever takes home her respective franchise's first title. The series now shifts back to Golden State, where the home team is a 1.5-point favorite on the spread and just -112 on the moneyline. Atlanta comes in at -108 and the over/under is set at 149.5. messages.content: [Walter Cup] The Walter Cup (French: La coupe Walter) is the championship trophy awarded to the winner of the Walter Cup playoffs (French: Séries éliminatoires de la Coupe Walter de la LPHF), which culminate in an annual best-of-five series that determines the champion of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL). The trophy is named in honour of PWHL co-founders and spouses Mark Walter and Kimbra Walter. Two teams have won the Cup since its establishment: the Minnesota Frost in both 2024 and 2025, and the Montreal Victoire in 2026. The Walter Cup is permanently on display at the Hockey Hall of Fame in Toronto. In contrast to the Stanley Cup, a replica of the Walter Cup is made for each year's champions.

messages.content:
Two teams have won the Cup since its establishment: the Minnesota Frost in both 2024 and 2025, and the Montreal Victoire in 2026.
On May 29, 2024, Minnesota became the first Walter Cup champions when they defeated Boston 3–0 in the fifth and deciding game of the inaugural season's championship series.
In 2026, the Montréal Victoire became the first Canadian team—and the first team other than Minnesota—to win the Walter Cup championship when they defeated the Charge in the Final.
On August 21, 2026, the PWHL reported that the replica of the trophy made for the 2026 champion Victoire went missing while in transit to Lethbridge, Alberta, the hometown of Victoire forward Dara Greig.
